entries.source: Limmir's Amulet of the Moon
entries.target: 利米尔的月亮项链

entries.source: So you can infuse amulets in this place?
entries.target: 这么说，你能在这里给项链附魔了？

entries.source: Urthol's Wondrous Emporium
entries.target: 乌瑟尔奇珍商场

entries.source:
Ah, my #{italic}#good#{normal}# friend @playername@!
Thanks to you I made it safely to this great city! I am planning to open my most excellent boutique soon, but since I am in your debt, perhaps I could open early for you if you are in need of rare goods.
entries.target:
啊，我的#{italic}#好#{normal}#朋友 @playername@！
多亏了你，我才得以安全抵达这座伟大的城市！我的精品商行准备近期正式开张，不过既然我欠你一份人情，要是你需要稀有货物，也许我可以提前为你破例营业。

entries.source: By the way,
entries.target: 顺带一提，

entries.source: during our escape I found the plans for an #YELLOW#Ambush Trap#LAST#
entries.target: 在逃亡途中我找到了一份#YELLOW#伏击陷阱#LAST#的设计图

entries.source: and while
entries.target: ，同时在

entries.source: while
entries.target: 在

entries.source: organizing my inventory, I came across some #YELLOW#Smelly Toxin#LAST# that a colleague claimed could actually turn creatures to stone.  Truly exotic!
entries.target: 整理货物时，我偶然发现了一些#YELLOW#恶臭毒素#LAST#，一位同行声称它竟然能将生物变成石头。真是奇特！

entries.source: You would not happen to be interested, by any chance?
entries.target: 不知你是否会感兴趣？

entries.source: Oh my friend, good news! As I told you I can now request a truly #{italic}#unique#{normal}# object to be crafted just for you. For a truly unique price...
entries.target: 噢我的朋友，好消息！正如我之前对你说的，我现在可以专门为你定制一件真正#{italic}#独一无二#{normal}#的物品了。当然，价格也同样独一无二……

entries.source: I eventually plan to arrange a truly unique service for the most discerning of customers. If you come back later when I'm fully set up I shall be able to order for you something quite marvellous. For a perfectly #{italic}#suitable#{normal}# price, of course.
entries.target: 我计划日后为最具眼光的顾客提供一项真正独特的服务。等我彻底布置停当，你日后再来的话，我将能为你订制一件绝妙的物品。当然，价格也会十分#{italic}#公道#{normal}#。

entries.source: Yes please, let me see your wares.
entries.target: 好的，让我看看你的货物。

entries.source: What about the unique object?
entries.target: 关于那件独一无二的物品呢？

entries.source: Ambush Trap?  Sounds useful.
entries.target: 伏击陷阱？听上去挺有用。

entries.source: Smelly Toxin?  What kind of smell?
entries.target: 恶臭毒素？什么样的气味？

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

entries.source:
You know, I have asked here and there and it happens to be a very rare thing this contraption...
But since you have saved me, I'm willing to part from it for only 3000 gold pieces, a real bargain!
entries.target:
你要知道，我四处打听过，这种机关可是极其罕见的玩意儿……
不过既然你救了我，我愿意只收 3000 金币就把它让给你，这可真划算！

entries.source: Expensive, but I will take it.
entries.target: 虽然很贵，不过我要了。

entries.source: Nice doing business with you my friend. There you go!
entries.target: 和你做生意真愉快，我的朋友。拿去吧！

entries.source: Thanks.
entries.target: 多谢。

entries.source:
Ungrol told me this substance contains some exceedingly rare components.
"More Toxin than Medicine" he said.  Allas, he had not the funds to buy it.  On the other hand, because of our special relationship, I'm willing to let you have it #{italic}#at cost#{normal}# -- only 1500 gold pieces!
entries.target:
温格洛告诉我，这种物质含有一些极其罕见的成分。
“与其说是药，不如说是毒。”他这么说。可惜他没有足够的资金买下来。不过鉴于我们的特殊关系，我愿意按#{italic}#成本价#{normal}#转让给你——只要 1500 金币！

entries.source: Fairly pricey, but seems useful.  We have a deal!
entries.target: 相当贵，不过看起来用得上。成交！

entries.source: That price ... er stuff really stinks ...
entries.target: 这价格……呃，我是说这东西确实够臭的……

entries.source: Here you are.  Just be sure not to get any on yourself!
entries.target: 给你。可千万小心别弄到自己身上！

entries.source: I normally offer this service only for a truly deserved price, but for you my friend I am willing to offer a 20% discount - #{italic}#only#{normal}# 4000 gold to make an utterly unique item of your choice.  What do you say?
entries.target: 我通常要收取与这项服务相称的价钱，但为了你，我的朋友，我愿意提供八折优惠——#{italic}#只要#{normal}# 4000 金币，就能按你的要求定制一件绝无仅有的装备。你意下如何？

entries.source: Why, 'tis a paltry sum - take my order, man, and be quick about it!
entries.target: 哈，这点小钱何足挂齿——收下我的订单，伙计，动作快点！

entries.source: Yes, please!
entries.target: 好的，拜托了！

entries.source: HOW MUCH?! Please, excuse me, I- I need some fresh air...
entries.target: 多少钱？！抱歉失陪，我……我得去透透气……

entries.source: Not now, thank you.
entries.target: 现在不用，多谢。

entries.source: dragonbone wand
entries.target: 龙骨魔杖

entries.source: dragonbone totem
entries.target: 龙骨图腾

entries.source: voratun torque
entries.target: 沃瑞钽项圈

entries.source: I've changed my mind.
entries.target: 我改变主意了。

entries.source: Which kind of item would you like ?
entries.target: 你想要哪种类型的装备？

entries.source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

entries.source:
Do you want to name your item?
%s
entries.target:
你想要命名你的物品吗？
%s

entries.source: Yes, please.
entries.target: 是的。

entries.source: Name your item
entries.target: 为你的装备命名

entries.source: Name
entries.target: 名称

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#The merchant carefully hands you: %s
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#商人小心地交给了你：%s

entries.source: No thanks.
entries.target: 不用了，谢谢。

entries.source: Oh I am sorry, it seems we could not make the item your require.
entries.target: 啊真抱歉，看来我们无法制作你所要求的装备。

entries.source: Oh, let's try something else then.
entries.target: 好吧，我们试试别的东西。

entries.source: Oh well, maybe later then.
entries.target: 好吧，以后再说。

entries.source: *This store does not appear to be open yet*
entries.target: *这家商店似乎尚未开张。*

entries.source: [leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A man talks to you from inside, the door half open. His voice is sad.*#WHITE#
Sorry, the store is closed.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门半开着，一个男人从屋里对你说话，声音听上去很悲伤。*#WHITE#
抱歉，商店打烊了。

entries.source: [leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source: @playername@! My daughter's savior!
entries.target: @playername@！我女儿的救命恩人！

entries.source: Hi, I was just checking in to see if Melinda is all right.
entries.target: 你好，我只是来看看梅琳达是否安好。

entries.source: Hi, I would like to talk to Melinda please.
entries.target: 你好，我想和梅琳达说说话。

entries.source: Melinda
entries.target: 梅琳达

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

entries.source: Please take this. It is nothing compared to the life of my child. Oh, and she wanted to thank you in person; I will call her.
entries.target: 请收下这个。比起我孩子的性命，这点礼物微不足道。哦，还有，她想当面向你道谢，我去叫她。

entries.source: Thank you.
entries.target: 谢谢。

entries.source: Melinda's father gives you: %s
entries.target: 梅琳达的父亲交给了你：%s

entries.source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

entries.source: @playername@! #LIGHT_GREEN#*She jumps for joy and hugs you while her father returns to his shop.*#WHITE#
entries.target: @playername@！#LIGHT_GREEN#*她高兴得跳了起来并紧紧拥抱你，而她的父亲则回到了店里。*#WHITE#

entries.source: I am glad to see you are fine. It seems your scars are healing quite well.
entries.target: 很高兴看到你平安无事。看来你的伤疤恢复得挺好。

entries.source: I am glad to see you well. Take care.
entries.target: 很高兴看到你身体安好。多保重。

entries.source:
Yes it has mostly healed, though I still do have nightmares. I feel like something is still lurking.
Ah well, the bad dreams are still better than the fate you saved me from!
entries.target:
是的，大多都已经愈合了，不过我还是会做噩梦。我总觉得还有什么东西潜伏着。
唉，不过做噩梦总比遭受那种悲惨命运好得多，你救了我，让我逃过了那一劫！

entries.source: Should I come across a way to help you during my travels, I will try to help.
entries.target: 如果我在旅途中找到能帮助你的办法，我会尽力帮你的。

entries.source: Thank you, you are most welcome.
entries.target: 谢谢，我非常欢迎你这样做。

entries.source: Most certainly, so what are your plans now?
entries.target: 那是自然。那么你现在有什么打算？

entries.source: Hi @playername@! I am feeling better now, even starting to grow restless...
entries.target: 你好，@playername@！我感觉好多了，甚至开始有点闲不住了……

entries.source: So what are your plans now?
entries.target: 那么你现在有什么打算？

entries.source: About that, I was thinking that maybe you'd like to go out with me sometime ...
entries.target: 说到这个，我在想也许你哪天愿意和我一起出去走走……

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Melinda appears at the door and kisses you*#WHITE#
Hi my dear, I'm so happy to see you!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*梅琳达出现在门口，亲吻了你*#WHITE#
嗨，亲爱的，见到你我太高兴了！

entries.source: I am still looking out for an explanation of what happened at the beach.
entries.target: 我还在试着弄清海滩上发生的事。

entries.source: About what happened on the beach, I think I have found something.
entries.target: 关于海滩上发生的事，我想我有些眉目了。

entries.source:
I do not know yet, my father won't let me out until I'm fully healed. I've always wanted to do so many things.
That is why I got stuck in that crypt, I want to see the world.
My father gave me some funds so that I can take my future into my own hands. I have some friends in Derth, maybe I will open my own little shop there.
entries.target:
我现在还不知道，在我完全康复之前我父亲都不准我出门。我一直想做很多事情。
我就是因为想去看看外面的世界，才会被困在那个地宫里。
我父亲给了我一笔钱，让我能够自己把握未来。我在德斯镇有几个朋友，也许我会在那里开一家属于自己的小店。

entries.source: I have seen how you fought those corruptors, the way you destroyed their magic. I want to learn to do the same, so that such horrors never happen again. To anyone.
entries.target: 我见过你对抗那些腐化者、摧毁他们魔法的样子。我也想学会这些，这样，可怕的惨剧就再也不会发生在任何人身上了。

entries.source:
Or maybe, well I suppose I can trust you with this, I've always secretly dreamed of learning magic. Real magic I mean not alchemist tricks!
I've learnt about a secret place, Angolwen, where I could learn it.
entries.target:
又或者……好吧，我想可以放心把这件事告诉你，我一直偷偷梦想着能学习魔法。我是指真正的魔法，而不是炼金术士的小把戏！
我得知了一个叫做安格利文的隐秘之地，在那里我就能学习魔法。

entries.source: Derth has its up and downs but I think they could do with a smart girl yes.
entries.target: 德斯镇虽有利有弊，但我想他们确实需要一个像你这样聪明的姑娘。

entries.source: Thanks!
entries.target: 谢谢！

entries.source: You wish to join our noble crusade against magic? Wonderful! I will talk to them for you.
entries.target: 你想加入我们对抗魔法的高尚圣战？太棒了！我会替你去和他们说说的。

entries.source: That would be very nice!
entries.target: 那真是太好了！

entries.source: I happen to be welcome among the people of Angolwen, I could say a word for you.
entries.target: 我恰好在安格利文挺受欢迎，我可以替你美言几句。
